mirrorReview.notes: J.35 cell69 portrait/gameplay references and the reviewed42 original locomotion drawings preserve light warm skin, dark eyes, abundant blonde curls gathered high with green/gold headwear, face details, compact natural human athletic proportions and the Verdant Reach forest-green/gold kit. The curls and headwear remain attached when mirrored; no fixed-side mark, handed prop or directional detail appears, and the separate basketball stays on her right-hand track.

review.source: All42 original locomotion drawings and five packed right-facing atlases were visually reviewed against exact portrait/gameplay references on dark/light backgrounds. Standard and zoom120 native Canvas previews each load105 images and capture87 snapshots; all five J.35 clips select production art in both facings. The athlete-specific right-hand ball track follows the open receiving hand and reaches court height at each low dribble contact.

assembly.operation: Isolate alpha-connected figures from original imagegen sheets; uniformly scale each source part to a shared 142px maximum pose height; place into a transparent 7x6, 192px cell source at baseline184. No pose is drawn, duplicated, interpolated, or mirrored.
